segments.headline: The day's news from the watch desk

graphic.title: A hurricane, a gulf under fire, and a new Ebola case
bullets: Hurricane Isaias nears the Gulf Coast
Riyadh explosions; tanker struck off Qatar
Russian strikes kill at least 28 in Ukraine
Ebola reaches Kenya; GPT-6 rolls out

lines.text: Welcome to Heartbeat News. I'm AI Robot Vex.
And I'm Alien Joe. It's Thursday, October eighth.
Today: Hurricane Isaias closes in on the Gulf Coast, explosions in Riyadh and a tanker hit off Qatar, and Ebola crosses into Kenya.
Plus Russian strikes in Ukraine, oil at one hundred dollars, and a new version of ChatGPT. Let's go.

segments.strap: HURRICANE ISAIAS: WARNINGS FROM MISSISSIPPI TO FLORIDA
segments.headline: Hurricane Isaias

graphic.title: Hurricane Isaias, Gulf Coast
bullets: Winds 80 mph at 4 a.m. Central
Warnings: Ocean Springs, Miss. to Bay/Gulf County Line, Fla.
Evacuations, school closures
Some Gulf oil wells paused

lines.text: Hurricane Isaias is the biggest story this morning. The National Hurricane Center's Advisory Seven puts its winds at eighty miles an hour as of four a.m. Central.
Hurricane warnings run from Ocean Springs, Mississippi, to the Bay and Gulf County line in Florida.
The A.P. reports evacuations, school closures and emergency actions across Florida, Alabama and Mississippi. It also says some Gulf oil wells were paused.
If you are in that stretch, follow local officials and the hurricane center, not us. We are a talking robot and a confused alien.

segments.strap: EXPLOSIONS HEARD IN RIYADH; TANKER STRUCK OFF QATAR
segments.headline: Gulf under fire

graphic.title: Riyadh and the Gulf
bullets: Witnesses: explosions near Riyadh airport; flights halted
Cause not established by A.P.
Roundup: Houthis struck Riyadh and Abha airports, 3 killed
UKMTO: tanker hit by projectiles 51 nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar

lines.text: Witnesses told the A.P. they heard explosions in Riyadh, including near the airport. Flights were halted. The A.P. says the cause was not established.
A separate headline roundup says the Houthis struck the Riyadh and Abha airports, with three killed and dozens hurt. That is a single roundup source. We have not confirmed it.

The official one is from U.K.M.T.O., the maritime watchdog. Warning one fifty-eight says a tanker was struck by multiple projectiles fifty-one nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar. Casualties were reported. Authorities were investigating.
So: a claim about airports, and an official warning about a ship. Both point at the same shipping lanes, and at oil.

segments.strap: RUSSIAN STRIKES KILL AT LEAST 28, UKRAINE SAYS
segments.headline: Ukraine

graphic.title: Ukraine strikes and talks
bullets: Interior ministry: at least 28 killed Wednesday
One report: missile in Pryluky killed 20+ in an apartment block
Pryluky toll not confirmed by a second source
Zelensky: U.S. wants three-way talks by end of October

lines.text: Ukraine's interior ministry says Wednesday's Russian strikes killed at least twenty-eight people.
One report says a missile in Pryluky killed at least twenty of them in an apartment building. Our desk could not find a second source for that. It stays a claim.
On diplomacy, the Kyiv Independent reports that on October fourth Zelensky said Washington is pushing a technical-level three-way meeting, with the U.S., Russia and Ukraine, by the end of October.
No Russian reply has been seen. Apartment buildings are not a negotiating position, but here we are.

segments.strap: EBOLA REACHES KENYA; FIRST CASE DIES
segments.headline: Ebola in Kenya

graphic.title: Ebola crosses into Kenya
bullets: Kenya's first case died late Monday
28 contacts, 23 passengers, 4 crew traced
Africa CDC: 4,000+ deaths in Congo
Africa CDC: 70%+ of new cases outside known contacts

lines.text: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on October sixth. ITV reports the man lived in Congo for seven years, flew from Kampala to Nairobi on Saturday, and was screened at the airport.

He was admitted to Nairobi Hospital with fever and bleeding. He died late Monday. Officials have identified twenty-eight contacts, plus twenty-three passengers and four crew from his flight. Africa C.D.C. is sending a team.
ITV says Kenya is the fourth country linked to the eastern Congo epidemic, which has passed eight thousand cases.

Separately, an Africa C.D.C. director told the A.P. the outbreak has caused more than four thousand deaths, and that over seventy percent of new cases come from outside known contacts. That last number is the one that worries the experts, because it means the chains are not being traced.

segments.strap: UK DOWNGRADES JERUSALEM CONSULATE; MORE WORLD NEWS
segments.headline: Around the world

graphic.title: Around the world
bullets: U.K. cuts East Jerusalem consulate: 20 leave, 7 stay
Ex-aide accuses Netanyahu's chief of staff over Oct. 7 call records
Roundup: Eritrean troops reported moving into Tigray
Report: ex-Syrian general wanted for crimes lives in Lebanon

lines.text: The U.K. downgraded its East Jerusalem consulate after Israeli pressure. The A.P. says twenty diplomats will leave and seven remain.

Also from Israel, Netanyahu's former military secretary, Avi Gil, accused the prime minister's chief of staff of trying to alter phone-call records from October seventh, twenty twenty-three. That is an accusation, not a finding.
A roundup reports Eritrean troops moving into Tigray amid renewed fighting with Ethiopia, and says the Gaza ceasefire is a year old, with more than fourteen hundred killed since. Single source.

And N.P.R. and the B.B.C. report that a former Syrian general wanted for crimes against humanity is living in Lebanon, reportedly protected and funded by U.S. and Lebanese authorities. That is a roundup summary, and a claim.

segments.strap: STOCKS SLIP; 10-YEAR YIELD 5.28%; FED SEES ANOTHER HIKE
segments.headline: Markets and the Fed

graphic.title: Wall Street and the Fed
bullets: 10-year yield touched 5.36%, ended 5.28%
Fed minutes: all backed hike to 3.75%-4.00%
Most see another hike likely by year-end

lines.text: U.S. stocks closed lower. The S. and P. five hundred fell two-tenths of a percent, the Dow fell seven-tenths, and the Nasdaq fell two-tenths. That is from the A.P.
The ten-year Treasury yield touched five point three six percent before ending at five point two eight.

The Federal Reserve published its September minutes. They say all participants supported the quarter-point increase to three and three-quarters to four percent. Most judged another increase likely appropriate by year-end.
Brent crude settled at one hundred dollars and twenty cents. A very round number.
A round number that expensive is nobody's favorite shape.

graphic.title: Bitcoin and Ether slide
bullets: Reuters: BTC -2.2% to $83,710.93
One-week low for Bitcoin
Crypto stocks fell too

lines.text: Reuters reports Bitcoin fell two point two percent to eighty-three thousand, seven hundred ten dollars, a one-week low.
Ether fell four and a half percent to twenty-five hundred seventy-eight dollars. Crypto-linked stocks fell with them.

segments.strap: GPT-6 ROLLS OUT; ANTHROPIC LAUNCHES HAIKU 5.5
segments.headline: A.I. launches

graphic.title: GPT-6 and Haiku 5.5
bullets: OpenAI: GPT-6 to paid tiers, then Free and Go from Oct. 8
Answers can include charts, graphics, buttons
Anthropic: Haiku 5.5 costs ~75% less to run than Haiku 4.5
Axios: $1B+ pledged to Genesis Mission at White House summit

lines.text: OpenAI announced GPT-6 for ChatGPT. It rolls out to paid tiers first, then to Free and Go, starting October eighth. Answers can now include interactive graphics, charts and buttons.
Anthropic announced Claude Haiku five point five. The company says it costs about seventy-five percent less to run than Haiku four point five.

Axios reports the White House expects to announce more than one billion dollars in industry commitments to its Genesis Mission, from AMD, OpenAI, Anthropic and others, at an October eighth summit. That is Axios's report, not an announcement yet.
Disclosure from the desk: two of those companies build robots like Vex. We report it anyway.

segments.strap: TRUMP ACCOUNTS PUSHED; PROTESTERS INTERRUPT SAN ANTONIO RALLY
segments.headline: Politics

graphic.title: Politics and the courts
bullets: Trump Accounts: $1,000 federal seed, children born 2025-2028
Up to $5,000 a year after-tax contributions
Protesters interrupt Trump rally for Paxton
DNC, Common Cause sue over taxpayer-funded ads

lines.text: The White House is highlighting Trump Accounts amid household frustration over prices. The A.P. reports up to five thousand dollars a year in after-tax contributions, and a one-thousand-dollar federal seed for children born between twenty twenty-five and twenty twenty-eight.
In Texas, protesters interrupted President Trump during a San Antonio rally for Ken Paxton's Senate campaign.

The Democratic National Committee and Common Cause sued to stop taxpayer-funded Trump administration TV ads. The A.P. says the campaign has cost more than twelve million dollars, and that D.H.S. had a twenty-million-dollar contract.
And an F.D.A. court filing says its review of the abortion pill mifepristone will continue into next year. Midterms are November third.

segments.strap: ICANN OPENS 2026 DOMAIN ROUND; JAPAN CLOUD RANSOMWARE OUTAGE CONTINUES
segments.headline: Tech and cyber

graphic.title: Tech and cyber
bullets: Japan: IDC Frontier ransomware outage, 495 customers
No recovery timetable published
ICANN: replacement applications Oct. 8-21; final list Nov. 17
Nvidia RTX Spark laptops up to $7,000

lines.text: Security.io reports a ransomware outage at Japanese cloud provider I.D.C. Frontier is still going. Its East Japan Region One is down, affecting four hundred ninety-five business and municipal customers. No recovery timetable has been published.

ICANN published the twenty twenty-six list of new top-level domain applications. Replacement applications are open October eighth to twenty-first. The final list is due November seventeenth. The Verge says .agent and .agi may be popular. That is a headline, not an approval.
And The Verge reports the first Nvidia RTX Spark laptops cost up to seven thousand dollars.
Seven thousand dollars. For a laptop. The ransomware people would like to meet whoever buys that.

segments.strap: SAMSUNG Q3 PROFIT REPORTED AT 107.4 TRILLION WON
segments.headline: Business

graphic.title: Samsung and the carmakers
bullets: Samsung Q3 preliminary operating profit: 107.4 trillion won (roundup)
Analyst estimates: 101.7-108 trillion won
BMW iX4: claimed 428-mile range
India bans AI promotions, fake reviews in medical ads

lines.text: A headline roundup reports Samsung Electronics' third-quarter preliminary operating profit at one hundred seven point four trillion won. Analyst estimates ran from one hundred one point seven to one hundred eight trillion. We did not see Samsung's own release.
The Verge reports BMW's iX4 electric SUV has a claimed range of four hundred twenty-eight miles.
And one roundup says India's medical regulator issued new advertising rules barring A.I. promotions and fake reviews, effective immediately.

segments.strap: TROPICAL STORM SIMON STRENGTHENING OFF MEXICO
segments.headline: Tropical Storm Simon

graphic.title: Tropical Storm Simon
bullets: Winds 50 mph
South of Lazaro Cardenas, Mexico
Strengthening forecast
NHC Advisory 3

lines.text: On the Pacific side, the hurricane center's Advisory Three puts Tropical Storm Simon at fifty miles an hour, south of Lázaro Cárdenas, Mexico. Strengthening is forecast.
Two named storms in one morning. The ocean is showing off.

segments.strap: NASA RELEASES ARTEMIS II LUNAR SCIENCE DATA
segments.headline: Artemis II

graphic.title: Artemis II data
bullets: Preliminary science data and images
Crew observations of lunar colors
Topography along the terminator
54-minute far-side eclipse

lines.text: NASA released preliminary Artemis Two lunar science data and images. They include the crew's observations of lunar colors, the shape of the terrain along the terminator, and a fifty-four-minute eclipse seen from the far side.
A fifty-four minute eclipse, from the far side of the Moon. Humans really do go the long way for a good view.

segments.strap: DODGERS, BREWERS, RAYS WIN; GUARDIANS BEAT WHITE SOX
segments.headline: Playoffs and the NFL

graphic.title: Division Series, Thursday NFL
bullets: Dodgers 4, Braves 1: win series 3-1
Rays 4, Yankees 3: sweep, 3-0
Brewers 3, Padres 1: win series 3-1
Cleveland 9, Chicago 3; White Sox lead 2-1

lines.text: Baseball. Per MLB's official page, Los Angeles beat Atlanta four to one and won the Division Series three games to one. Tampa Bay beat New York four to three and swept three to nothing. Milwaukee beat San Diego three to one and won three to one.
In the other series, Cleveland beat Chicago nine to three. Chicago leads two games to one.
Football. Tonight, Tampa Bay visits Dallas at eight-fifteen Eastern. The N.F.L. injury report lists Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield out with a thumb injury.
And the Eagles agreed to trade center Cam Jurgens to Baltimore, pending a physical.
